reviews.review: Well, on my current computers I seem to be unable to get past a glitch in the Omega DLC; however, I did like playing the first three games back when I had a better computer. Wish I could afford to make this work, hopefully someday I shall. Either way, I love this game series; it's one of the best ever made. Mass Effect 3 might not have been as good as the second game, but it was still fairly well done; I just wish I could run it without it crashing or going to a blank screen and requiring hard reboot. But yeah, if you have a good enough system to run it properly, then hopefully it should work fine.

The Legendary Edition is great for the story. But the multiplayer was a gem, and it's a nice little kick of nostalgia. It's fun being able to play co-op as an Asari, Drell, Turian, or even Volus... Assuming you eventually get the lootbox drop. Further, it's pretty difficult to do the multiplayer by yourself. Thankfully, there's a somewhat active player base.

I liked the game it was cool and fun and reminded me of star wards kotor 2 which was fun. I think its a little confusing but it feels like Fortnite if Fortnite was a little more confusing but it was fun adn I like the visuals

I mostly bought it for the Multiplayer which is still decently active even now so you can easily get into it,and you easily find dedicated groups to find players of all skill ranges to play with. Just do not try Platinum at least for a while,trust me,stick with Gold for challenging coop matches,Platinum is the equivalent of Expert Realism in L4D2 where the average lobby can't really handle it.

As for the single player,it has some of the best and worst moments of the trilogy,if you know,you know.

For the combat,which was the department where the devs focused as EA rushed them to make the finale cause ofc...EA,it is at it's best in Multiplayer where you actually need teamwork to progress further,as enemies often tend to group up and gang up on your team with different tactics depending on the faction.

[spoiler]My preference: Collectors>Reapers>Cerberus>Geth [/spoiler]

As for my overall thoughts on ME3...it's a fun game albit the DLCs and the Multiplayer carry it.
If only Bioware made a ME game with the storytelling and worldbuilding of ME1,characters of 2,and the combat of 3,but nah,we got MEA instead...oh well,at least we can still enjoy the trilogy.

Last thing I wanna mention,if you do not care about the Multiplayer at all,just buy the remastered trilogy,if you wanna try the Multiplayer.go ahead,it's still worth it. I am new to it myself!

[h1] 8/10 [/h1]
